text:
Scapin, Dreamer,

rubs his kitten

under his protector.


Sweet Columbine,

already expert in love

—do, mi, sol, do—, stirs


the sapping eye

which, suddenly, seeps through,

drunk, its ardor.

translation.title: Galant Fête
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the commedia figures, musical syllables, and teasing erotic absurdity.
